notes: Poison Cleansing Totem recovers Envenom applications after missed interrupts; Spirit Walk, Thunderous Paws, or Wind Rush Totem with Jet Stream remove Paralyzing Shots slows.
Earthbind Totem slows fixating Hatchlings; this is movement control, not a spell-school interrupt.
Poison Cleansing Totem removes Toxic Spew. Spirit Walk removes the Shaman's Bloodthorn Roots and Spore Spines movement impairment; Jet Stream covers eligible group snares but is not a root cleanse.
Cleanse Toxic Spores and Insatiable Hunger, Purge Healing Breeze if its cast completes, and use Spirit Walk on Glacial Tomb or Frigid Roar.
Wind Rush Totem with Jet Stream is the group snare answer; it does not replace Spirit Walk for roots.
Poison Cleansing Totem removes Heartstop Poison, Cleanse Spirit answers Curse of Doom, and Purge removes Fel Crazed.
Tremor Totem clears landed Seduction and Thunderstorm can stop its susceptible channel; neither should replace a planned Wind Shear interrupt.
Poison Cleansing Totem covers Poison Splash, Mind-Numbing Poison, and Corrosive Essence; Spirit Walk or Jet Stream answers Violent Sand and Condensed Mass snares.

Thunderstorm can stop Mending Void by displacement and Tremor Totem can recover a missed Mad Shriek, but Wind Shear remains the reliable school lockout; no dungeon-specific root target is established.
Cleanse the listed poisons and Addle Mind, and Purge Accumulate Charge.
Earthbind Totem slows healer-fixating Faithless Tormentors; Thunderstorm can stop A Knot of Snakes, but displacement is distinct from an interrupt.
Poison Cleansing Totem and Cleanse Spirit cover Lingering Fluid, Poison Nova, Serpent Strike, Hex Volley, and Hex; Purge Unholy Mending.
Spirit Walk removes the listed personal snares and Tremor Totem clears Deathly Roar or Pit of Despair after missed stops; no dungeon-specific root target is established.
Purge Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier. Wind Rush Totem with Jet Stream removes eligible Cold Claws snares for the group.

recommendations: Capacitor Totem with Static Charge or carefully placed Thunderstorm can clear clustered orbs; avoid scattering normal enemies.
No dedicated utility talent is required; swap quickly and use short-cooldown burst on the emissary.
